observations: Two Sony PS4 Pro consoles are stacked on a white surface.
Two red DualShock 4 wireless controllers in retail packaging are placed on top of the consoles.
The consoles feature the distinctive three-tier chassis design of the PS4 Pro model.
A watermark 'GAME ARENAOFFICAL' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' is visible across the center of the image.
Yellow tape strips are visible on the sides of both consoles, commonly used by local retailers for inventory marking.
Power and possibly other cables are plugged into the rear of the consoles.
No physical games or a UK receipt are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No games are shown in the photo.
The rear warranty seals are not visible in the photo.
No receipt is shown in the photo.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a hardware fault (e.g., Blue Light of Death).
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the dashboard and running a game.

risks.risk: The console may have been opened for repairs, which contradicts the seller's claim.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the intact warranty seal on the back of the console.

risks.risk: The boxed controllers may be high-quality clones rather than original Sony hardware.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the stickers on the back of the controllers.

risks.risk: The 10 games may be digital accounts (which can be revoked) or missing entirely.
risks.proof: A photo of 10 physical game discs or cases.

proof_requests: Photo of the 10 games and the UK receipt.
Photo of the back of the console to check the warranty seal.
Video of the console powered on and working.
Confirmation of whether the price is for one or both consoles shown in the photo.
response.reason: The photo shows two consoles while the text describes one, and the watermark suggests a generic shop photo rather than the specific item for sale. Proof of the specific unit, its functional state, and the mentioned games is required before a price can be set.
